userDirection: Founding reference is primary: sun-faded cream/sand/pale ochre, golden warmth and cooler contrast; maintained, well-used minor damage/erosion and sandy/dirty flooring.
distinction: Inherited scan wear remains inside source albedo/normal/roughness. Authored wear is a separate bounded treatment at named receivers; evaluate their combined appearance. Raw samples are not final materials.
existingLimits: Existing floor edgeDust width 0.18m, alpha ceiling 0.06, feather 0.06m; existing wall contactBand height 0.18m, alpha ceiling 0.045, vertices at 0/0.12/0.18m. Treat these as ceilings for selected receiver patches, not a requirement to dirty every edge or floor.
drainRule: Listed collectors are concealed rear collectors. Their IDs do not authorize a stain on the street face. Do not invent a drain or stain; only an actually exposed authored discharge and its verified receiving surface may receive the SD-14 local mark.
